body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Paris, France. The listing gives its length as 1 hours, over a route of about 1 km. It starts at Rodin Museum, Rue de Varenne, 77. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Ticket to The Rodin Museum. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Explore the Rodin Museum in Paris with this self-guided audio tour, which includes an entrance ticket! Auguste Rodin is one of the most significant sculptors in the history of art. He is known for his deep understanding of the human soul and his ability to capture emotions and anxieties using various materials.
>
> You will visit the mansion that once served as the sculptor’s studio and see models of some of his most important works. The stories behind these masterpieces will unfold as you explore the collection at your own pace guided by an engaging audio commentary on your phone. Then, you will take a walk through the garden and see The Gates of Hell, The Kiss, and The Thinker. You will also find works by Camille Claudel, his student and lover, and also a very talented sculptress in her own right.
>
> Prepare to plunge into the fascinating world of Rodin!
>
> Note! This tour is not affiliated with the Rodin Museum but is provided by an independent creator. An e-ticket is included for the customer's convenience at no charge.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.35. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 519 ratings and 180 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
